name: Hultsjö - Sävsjö
description: Hultsjö to Sävsjö. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
utilities: Anslutning Sävsjö C - HÖ12/HÖ13 / Sävsjö station (transit)
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Smålandsleden/Naturkartan HÖ12 exposes no closure/current status, but Sävsjö municipality reported the Eksjöhovgårdssjön exercise loop fully closed after Storm Dave on 2026-04-07.
HÖ12 official prose names Bockudden shelter as an overnight option, but geometry places it on a separate side trail. Official spur length is 0.9 km; computed GPX/API is 0.808 km.
Connector is titled HÖ12/HÖ13 and officially supports station access, but linework attaches near HÖ13 about 421 m from the HÖ12 endpoint.
Official HÖ12 route text references Hultsjö and Hjärtlanda 1100s churches, while Svenska kyrkan says current Hultsjö church was built 1859-1860.
Official HÖ12 prose says Sävsjö slottsruin, while linked facility/municipal sources use Eksjöhovgårds slottsruin.
Official HÖ12 prose names water at Hultsjö and Hjärtlanda cemeteries, but no exact tap coordinates or seasonal reliability were found.
